Enabling the filter is the whole of the setup; every option is optional.

```yaml
filters:
  - remember
```

Scroll this page, leave it, and come back: a prompt offers to put you where you were, and says how long ago that was.
Declining clears the stored position rather than asking again.

Opt pages out when they are not worth resuming:

```yaml
extensions:
  remember:
    page-exclude:
      - /search.html
      - /drafts/*
```

In a book the chapter is remembered as well, and a return visit redirects to it.
In a RevealJS deck the slide indices are stored instead.

{{< lipsum 5 >}}

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-remember/>.
